name: On the Lam
summary: A caravan rumor points to Horde marauders who fled Desolace after attacks on human and dwarf camps. You are sent toward Booty Bay to find one of them.

sections.title: A Trail to Booty Bay
sections.body: A caravan contact describes attacks on human and dwarf camps in Desolace, then points you toward Booty Bay. The victims and the violence have led caravans to suspect Horde marauders. An Alliance marshal pursued the bandits, and they left Desolace. Now you are asked to find one of them.

faq.answer: Caravan rumor blames a group of Horde marauders for attacks on human and dwarf camps in Desolace.
The bandits fled Desolace after an Alliance marshal pursued them. Booty Bay is suggested as a place to look for one.
The contact suggests Booty Bay because people of doubtful character pass through its port, and a marauder might be seeking a boat.
You are looking for one of the marauders from Desolace.

attribution: In-game quest text: On the Lam
